verdict.rationale: The Supabase CLI runs the full stack locally or in CI, and per a hands-on user `supabase start` builds the database from migration .sql files. Migrations are also a first-class concept: the MCP server exposes `list_migrations`/`apply_migration`, and branching gives per-PR preview environments for schema changes. Community users call the migration and local-dev story a weakness and note the dashboard encourages live prod edits, but that is criticism rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence without making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of CLI migration commands (creating, diffing, pushing migrations to a hosted project), a documented CI pipeline for applying migrations to production, and positive independent corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
